goal: archive_completed_phases refuses to move a loop-path-marked phase to archive/ unless the phase contains a DONE task tagged in-loop-verification or a recorded opt-out artifact, leaving a blocked phase active and logging the refusal reason.

references: src/flywheel/workflow.py:1114 (archive_completed_phases) -- the gate attaches here, just before shutil.move; existing all-tasks-done check is at 1135-1138.
flywheel.loop_path_marker (loop-path-diff-marker) -- derives signals from the phase's cumulative diff (phase-base-diff helper).
flywheel.workflow opt-out loader (loop-path-optout-artifact) -- the downgrade path.
load_task_file(p).tags and _has_done_lifecycle(store, id) -- how the gate recognizes a DONE in-loop-verification task.
constraints: Derive the marker from the phase's cumulative diff-vs-base; a phase is gated ONLY when the marker is non-empty. An empty marker (no watched signal, or no recorded base) archives exactly as today.
The recognized verify-task marker is a phase task carrying the tag `in-loop-verification`; the gate passes when such a task has a DONE lifecycle OR an opt-out artifact is present for the phase.
A gated phase stays in active/ and the refusal reason is logged via the same logging seam archive_phases uses (.workflow/worker.py:453); the function stays idempotent.

Add tests for the FR-2 acceptance: a marked phase with all feature tasks DONE but no verify task and no opt-out is NOT archived; adding a DONE in-loop-verification task lets the next sweep archive it; an opt-out artifact alone also lets it archive.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file you touch and fix all Pylance errors before reporting verify.
